verses: Then I saw the souls of a man and a woman whose tongues were cut out.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by these bodies, whose souls suffer so severe a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked man and woman who, amongst the living, spoke much falsehood and profanity or untruth, and deceived their own souls.'
